item.tib: mkha' 'gro rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum gsang chen rol pa zang thal gyi rgyud
mkha' 'gro rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum gsang chen rol pa zang thal gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po
item.coloph: ces pa yang sprel lo zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin par / gsang chen dur khrod gnas brgyad du rig 'dzin gyi gral du phyin nas mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma la sogs zab lam shes rab kyi ma rgyud dang / rig 'dzin gyer spungs chen po la sogs rig pa thabs kyi rgyud pa'i pho rgyud gnyis la yang nye ba'i brgyud dang ring po'i brgyud bcas so sor du bstan nas brgyud/ de na lo dus kyi rgya yol tshe shing pho byi ba'i lor zab don brda ris su spel ba dge'o//

item.tib: mkha' 'gro rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum gsang chen rol pa zang thal gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po
